# Contributing

Campfire is developed mainly by a small team – currently three people. The code is open under the MIT license, so you are very welcome to read it, learn from it, and reuse it. We are not actively seeking outside contributions and may not be able to review or accept every proposal.

If you would still like to help or report something:

- **Questions and ideas** – members of the contingent use Discord. There is no public support channel; the code is simply open to read and reuse.
- **Bugs, features, and tasks** – open a GitHub issue using the templates. Every change starts with an issue.
- **Code** – the workflow and conventions live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md): branch from the issue, follow Conventional Commits, open a pull request, and let it merge by rebasing. The pull request checklist is the definition of done.

For anything larger than a small fix, open an issue and agree on the approach first, so no one's effort is wasted.

By taking part, you agree to the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
